notes.title: Valefar Chapter 1
notes.content:
Valefar Demo Update

We've pushed out the first chapter of Valefar for your next experience. New assets include:


 New backgrounds.
 A placeholder CG in the meantime.
 New music.


In order to reach his prelude, you would need to start from the regular prologue of the common route and head to his ending. Let us know what you think of his story!

notes.title: Demo Update #2
notes.content:
We've pushed an update again this week in order to resolve Steam Deck compatibility issues. If you own a Steam Deck and are still experiencing some bugs, please let us know in the Community Discussions or over at our Discord server in our Bug Reports channel. Any input you provide us gets us closer to a smoother release!


You may have heard that our game's founder, Esha, is roaming around Anime Expo with some sweet Salvus Aries bookmarks - if you happen to see her don't be shy and chat a bit!


 Updated game engine's dependencies.
 Updated Steamworks SDK library.

notes.title: Demo Patch
notes.content:
Appreciate the player who posted recently in our bug-reports channel. We made a small update to the demo to fix the following below.


 Fixed the missing sprites in Chapter 3.
 Fixed the missing sprites in Chapter 4.
 Reworked the audio mixer.


We're aware of the issues currently being experienced by Steam Deck users and we're in the process of fixing this issue Please join our Discord server and relay any specific details you've seen to the Dev team over at our Bug Report Channel.

notes.title: Salvus: Aries Demo is out now on Steam!
notes.content:
Salvus: Aries Demo is out now on Steam!

IF on steamdeck please use desktop mode. If you need to use the keyboard, steam + x button will bring it up. If it does not, tap outside the game window and it will work. 

New and improved assets, a new character sprite has been introduced, and an additional route for one of our romantic interests! In addition to that, we've added a History Log where you can replay your voice lines and read back on some interesting plot points. 

Our team has been hard at work cooking up before the official release next year, so stay up to date on our Twitter, TikTok, and our Discord Server.

Head on over to our Store page below and Wishlist us for when we officially release. The link to download the demo will be there for you to play through and enjoy!

 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2104400/Salvus_Aries/
